text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Flap flap!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The tall stack of books collapsed, scattering across the floor.
Catching sight of an open page from one I picked up,
my hand froze."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Pages filled with sticky notes and scribbles.
The traces of a fierce struggle, of running relentlessly forward.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I closed the book and put it away in the cabinet.
With a brand-new notebook in hand, I left the room—"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Ah, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Good Mile-ning!
choice_data_list: Good morn-mile! How are you feeling today?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: "Completely normal, a half & half mile!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Howdy, Gran!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: We're about to go on a wave run! Would you like to join us, Gran?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Are these for sprint, mile, or medium distances?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
It is a 2000m middle-distance race!
Kris S has been invited
to an exhibition race!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: I—struggle to gain—speed.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Using Taiki and Gran as references—
I want to devise a counter-strategy.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Understood!
Trainer, that's not a problem, right?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"Still, asking which of the three classes is best...
Hearing it put like that is pretty overwhelming, huh."

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, you've got plenty to choose from!
I promise you the strongest run at any distance!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, that's reassuring!
Well then, shall we get started?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
My Rule!
"Walk behind Rob Roy-senpai!"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Ah, yes...! H-Here you go...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
U-Uuu... It's always like this,
but being in the lead makes me restless...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Why are all of you doing this too...?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Stand tall, walk proud!
Alright, let's head to the woodchip course!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Kris S, your horseshoe's coming loose!
Be careful!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Ah, thanks.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Well then, from the start!
Trainer-san, please give the signal!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: ...And with that, the discomfort by 0.01 miles—

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Trainer, look over there!
It's Master!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa, you're wearing a suit today!
It's so classy, you're like a 23-mile dandy!

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Haha, don't tease me.
I was just visiting the URA today.

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text: Yeah. Starting next year, I'll be working at the URA.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Eeeh?! Is that true?!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
If Master continues to be involved with racing,
as an Umamusume, it makes me really happy!
choice_data_list: Looks like things are gonna turn around for the better!
Looks like things are going to change for the better!

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Haha, you're acting like it's none of your business,
but it's all thanks to you guys, you know?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Ours?

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. ...The sight you all showed me
at the Tenno Sho (Autumn).

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Countless fans empathized deeply with the
Umamusume, cheering as if it were their own struggle.

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
"Dreaming, crying,
and laughing, just like an Umamusume..."

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Fans like that used to be a minority.
But at the Tenno Sho (Autumn), they completely changed the atmosphere of the stands!

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text: —It's because you all reached out to new fans through your videos.

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text: I conveyed to them the excitement of racing, and the truth of the Umamusume who challenge it.

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
"That sparked interaction between new fans and longtime fans...
and created a whole wave of excitement."

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
The joy of sharing victory with countless fans.
—An Umamusume's true happiness.

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text: Even though I knew that, I couldn't find a way to get the fans involved.

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
You were the ones
who showed me the path to get there.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"We wanted to pass on Master's teachings,
which is why we've been uploading videos."

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
The huge swell that was created wasn't a coincidence...
No, it was all thanks to everyone, all the fans!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
At the Tenno Sho (Autumn), I got so much
passionate cheering. I truly felt that 30-mile impact!

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
“Yes. That is why I intend to work on it in the URA as well.
Initiatives that connect the fans with the Umamusume.”

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Wah!
That's infinitely miles fantastic!

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Everything you have brought to us...
I will make sure to carry it forward with pride.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu!
Trainer... here, please take a handkerchief.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"The next menu is soccer!
Shall we head over?"
Gran-chan!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Which race will you be running in next, I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: I haven't decided yet, Ai-senpai.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Then I think a mile would be best!
I want to compete against you at your absolute strongest.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
In that case, I want to race Eye-senpai
at 1.25 miles too!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"...Then both the Mile and 2000m,
both of them!"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: You're right! Let's settle once and for all who's the strongest!
choice_data_list: Umm... you mean for your next race?

text_block_list.name: Gran & Ai
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...It seems our immediate plans have been decided.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, here she comes.
Gran-chaaan!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Sorry to keep you waiting!
Is everyone here yet?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
Everyone who wished to participate as well.

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
I'm looking forward to working with you today!
I'll be taking plenty of notes from you and your team's training, Gran-san!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Yeah, learn as much as you can!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I want to incorporate training
based on 'Uma Musume First'――

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With more Umamusume and Trainers making such requests,
we've frequently been holding joint training sessions lately.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
How should we split into teams?
We're definitely gonna need to give Gran-chan a handicap.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Loves-chan, Chrono-chan, and Bouquet-san on the same team.
How about I team up with everyone else?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Plus, even as keeper,
I'm only gonna use my legs!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Okay!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Keep dribbling just like that, Bouquet-chan!

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Damn it, she passed me!
This is bad, right before the finish line...!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Chrono-san, please!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes...! S-Shoot...!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Whoa, I'm not letting you break through this goal!

text_block_list.name: Gran & Chrono
text_block_list.text:
Teryah!
...Eek!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Just as Chrono Genesis was about to shoot,
Gran Alegria rushed in and kicked the ball clear!"

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Gran-san, nice clear!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I-I was so startled
that I ended up running away...

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Ah, did I startle you?
Sorry about that.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
N-No, this is a competition, after all...!
Next time, I'm definitely making the shot...!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Fufu, I'm gonna stop you again!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Nice fight, both of you!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —After three years of triumphs, Gran Alegria is now surrounded by countless smiling faces.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The future my mentor aimed for with 'Umamusume First.'

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Miler!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Gran Alegria.
She will continue to weave that future ahead—
